items.headline: Miller and Walendzak combine for nearly 300 yards rushing, lead Toledo to 39-24 win over Ball State
items.description: — CJ Miller and Connor Walendzak combined for 299 yards rushing and three touchdowns to lead Toledo to a 39-24 victory over Ball State on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for the Rockets.

items.headline: DeShields accounts for 3 TDs, Kent State tops Ball State 26-13 in MAC opener
items.description: — Dru DeShields threw for two touchdowns and ran for another to lead Kent State to a 26-13 win over Kent State in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams on Saturday.
